Judul: Enhancing Supply Chain Efficiency through Retrieve-Augmented Generation Approach in Large Language Models
Problem: Industri rantai pasok menghadapi tantangan di lanskap global yang VUCA (Volatility, Uncertainty, Complexity, and Ambiguity) serta gangguan seperti konflik Laut Merah, Terusan Panama yang kering, perang di Ukraina, dan peningkatan E-commerce. Selain itu, Large Language Models (LLM) saat ini masih menghadapi tantangan seperti halusinasi, kurangnya atribusi sumber, dan keusangan cepat yang bermasalah dalam pengaturan perusahaan yang membutuhkan akurasi dan keandalan tinggi.
Metodologi: Mengintegrasikan pendekatan Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) dengan Large Language Models (LLM) yang menggunakan sistem dua komponen (modul retrieval untuk mengambil informasi dari basis pengetahuan dan modul generation untuk menyusun respons kontekstual). Penelitian ini menerapkan strategi seperti pengambilan rekursif (recursive retrieval), kueri multi-hop, optimalisasi chunk (misalnya blok 512 token), metode FLARE, RETRO, serta metode ITER-RETGEN, yang diuji melalui eksperimen pengaturan klasifikasi data perusahaan, analisis biaya rantai pasok global dengan kutipan, dan Master Production Schedule (MPS) dengan tiga strategi inventaris.
Temuan: RAG dengan LLM mampu menghasilkan respons yang andal dan tepat terhadap kueri rantai pasok dan logistik yang kompleks, membantu mitigasi risiko, meningkatkan akurasi peramalan, mengoptimalkan tingkat persediaan, menilai risiko pemasok, dan menyusun laporan rantai pasok komprehensif. Pada eksperimen MPS, RAG berhasil menyoroti kekuatan dan kelemahan dari tiga strategi inventaris (Even Build Strategy, Build Ahead Strategy, dan No Inventory Strategy) untuk memandu pengambilan keputusan strategis.
Keterbatasan_Penelitian: RAG memerlukan pertimbangan etis yang ketat dan countermeasures yang kuat terhadap eksploitasi, serta tantangan dalam menavigasi diskontinuitas semantik dan akumulasi data yang tidak relevan karena ketergantungan urutan token.
Future_Work: Fokus pada skalabilitas sistem, metrik evaluasi tingkat lanjut, dan kolaborasi interdisipliner antara pembelajaran mesin, sistem retrieval, dan domain rantai pasok.

File_Sumber: Runtime Prediction for Local Deployment of Large LanguageModels A Case Study on Qwen Models Covering LoRAFine-Tuning, RAG, and Inference.pdf
Judul: Runtime Prediction for Local Deployment of Large Language Models: A Case Study on Qwen Models Covering LoRA Fine-Tuning, RAG, and Inference
Penulis: ['Jian Guo', 'Jianwen Wei', 'Yufei Cheng', 'Jiajie Sheng', 'Yijun Wu', 'Kento Sato']
Problem: Local deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) faces significant challenges due to high computational demands and unpredictable runtime behavior. Most prior studies emphasize throughput or energy consumption, while systematic runtime prediction across diverse task types remains underexplored.
Metodologi: Controlled experiments were conducted on multi-GPU A100 clusters, varying the number of GPUs, model size, data scale, batch size, and concurrency. Predictive models were constructed using polynomial feature expansion and ridge regression, with logarithmic transformations and non-negativity constraints.
Dataset: Subsets of the Stanford Alpaca dataset (10 KB, 50 KB, 500 KB) for LoRA fine-tuning; corpus drawn from Romance of the Three Kingdoms (modern Chinese translation) for RAG, GraphRAG, and inference tasks.
Temuan: Results demonstrate strong predictive performance, with R2 values exceeding 0.9 (ranging from 0.88 to 0.97 across tasks) and mean absolute percentage errors (MAPEs) below 16% (ranging from 10.6% to 15.8%). LoRA fine-tuning runtime is primarily influenced by data size and batch size, GraphRAG runtime is dominated by model size, and inference runtime depends heavily on concurrency and input length.
Future_Work: (i) Extrapolation to larger model scales, (ii) low-precision quantized inference, (iii) multi-platform energy efficiency comparison, (iv) framework- and environment-level generalization, and (v) extension to energy consumption modeling and broader LLM families.

File_Sumber: Large language models in manufacturing a comprehensive review.pdf
Judul: Large language models in manufacturing: a comprehensive review
Penulis: Mazdak Maghanaki, Mohammad Shahin, F. Frank Chen
Problem: Traditional manufacturing systems and standard machine learning/rule-based expert systems are restricted by a narrow focus on specific tasks, extensive manual effort required for feature engineering and data labeling, brittle performance outside training parameters, and an inability to process unstructured information (such as handwritten notes or static documents), leaving industrial knowledge largely inaccessible.
Metodologi: A systematic review following PRISMA-informed guidelines. A comprehensive search was conducted across major scientific databases (Scopus, Web of Science, IEEE Xplore, ScienceDirect, and Google Scholar) using keywords related to Large Language Models and manufacturing, supplemented by backward and forward snowballing. A total of 151 studies were included in the final qualitative synthesis after applying specific exclusion criteria.
Dataset: Various datasets mentioned across the literature review sectors, including EV supply chain dataset, FAF database, NOAA, news, traffic datasets (e.g., Georgia hubs), MATSim Singapore simulation, custom pyramid datasets, NEU surface defect dataset, MVTec Anomaly Detection dataset, DAGM surface defect dataset, magnetic tile surface defect dataset, Kaputt dataset, NASA C-MAPSS turbofan engine degradation dataset, AI4I 2020 Predictive Maintenance Dataset, SCANIA Component X time-series dataset, MetroPT predictive maintenance dataset, MIMII dataset, and multiple tabular, time-series, log, and image datasets cited in prior studies.
Temuan: LLMs act as cognitive bridges that transition manufacturing systems from passive data-driven tools toward autonomous decision-making agents capable of reasoning, planning, and supporting complex operational control across eight key manufacturing sectors (supply chain & raw material procurement, logistics & transportation management, inventory management, product design & engineering, production planning & scheduling, manufacturing execution & floor operations, quality control, and maintenance). They improve operational efficiency, automate workflows, assist in robotics and predictive maintenance, and enhance human-machine interaction while requiring data quality, retrieval mechanisms, and expert oversight.
Keterbatasan_Penelitian: Technical and operational limitations include data integrity and model reliability issues in procurement, handling dynamic routing environments and low-frequency/emerging product demands in logistics, demand forecasting errors and overfitting in inventory control, lack of precision and domain-specific grounding in engineering design, handling high combinatorial complexity and stochastic disruptions in production planning, misclassification of rare or subtle defects in quality control, and challenges in temporal reasoning and sensor telemetry noise/inconsistent intervals in predictive maintenance.
Future_Work: Developing practical recommendations and adaptive frameworks to improve reliability, interpretability, and integration in industrial settings. This includes implementing rigorous data governance and curation protocols, hybrid approaches combining neural and symbolic techniques or small domain-specific models, multimodal data fusion, continuous model retraining, real-time tracking integration, and structured human-in-the-loop oversight.

File_Sumber: Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models for Real-Time Supply Chain Disruption Intelligence and Decision Support.pdf
Judul: Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models for Real-Time Supply Chain Disruption Intelligence and Decision Support
Problem: Large language models have parametric knowledge that is frozen at their training cutoff date, making them structurally incapable of reasoning over emerging, real-time supply chain disruptions (such as port closures, supplier bankruptcies, customs disruptions, or extreme-weather events) which lose decision value when stale. Most disruption-intelligence workflows still rely on manual analyst review of documents taking days to produce, while existing literature separates retrieval, reasoning, and decision support without a unified real-time architecture.
Metodologi: Mengusulkan framework agentic berbasis retrieval-augmented generation bernama RAGENT-SC yang mengombinasikan 5 lapisan: (i) knowledge layer (indeks vektor dan knowledge graph rantai pasok yang terus diperbarui), (ii) hybrid retrieval layer (pencarian vektor padat dan penelusuran graf berbasis sentralitas dengan anggaran 30-50 node), (iii) grounded generation layer (pembuatan teks berbasis bukti dengan metadata provenance), (iv) agentic orchestration layer (7 agen khusus untuk monitoring, analisis, perencanaan, negosiasi, dan audit), dan (v) governance layer (verifikasi halusinasi, pemeriksaan guardrail, dan eskalasi human-in-the-loop).
Dataset: Mencakup berbagai set data literatur yang direferensikan: 30 skenario sintetis (mencakup 3 produsen otomotif dan 5 kelas gangguan), dataset ekstraksi knowledge graph rantai pasok kendaraan listrik berisi 1.277 kalimat, benchmark SCM dengan 8 fungsi inti rantai pasok dan dataset QA chatbot LTU, repositori berita India longitudinal dengan ~3,88 juta baris (2001–2023), serta testbed pengujian penskalaan retrieval vektor-graf hibrida.
Temuan: Framework RAGENT-SC dan literatur terkait menunjukkan bahwa pendekatan berbasis agen dan RAG dapat mendeteksi, menganalisis, dan merespons gangguan dengan skor F1 antara 0,962 hingga 0,991, menyelesaikan analisis end-to-end dalam rata-rata 3,83 menit dengan biaya $0,0836 per gangguan (pengurangan lebih dari tiga kali lipat ordo besmagnitude dibandingkan analisis manual). Penalaran LLM berbasis graf (graph-grounded) meningkatkan ROUGE-1 F1 dari 0,42 menjadi 0,67 (peningkatan 59%). Retrieval vektor-graf hibrida berskala sublinier (menggandakan waktu kueri dari 0,09s ke 0,20s saat jumlah node berlipat empat). Kualitas retrieval (terutama fine-tuning model embedding) terbukti menjadi faktor penentu utama dibandingkan skala model.
Keterbatasan_Penelitian: Hasil yang dilaporkan mencakup tugas, dataset, dan model yang heterogen alih-alih menggunakan satu benchmark terkontrol tunggal; penerapan RAG pada rantai pasok dibatasi oleh ketiadaan basis pengetahuan domain-spesifik yang berkualitas tinggi; pekerjaan benchmark pada orkestrasi alat jangka panjang menunjukkan celah keandalan eksekusi yang substansial; serta pilihan model LLM secara material memengaruhi kualitas ekstraksi.
Future_Work: Future work akan (i) mengimplementasikan RAGENT-SC secara end-to-end pada rantai pasok komoditas langsung dengan evaluasi terpadu lintas protokol gaya-Bench; (ii) membangun dan terus memperbarui basis pengetahuan domain berkualitas tinggi yang menjadi hambatan terdokumentasi; (iii) memperdalam retrieval graf dengan penelusuran berbasis sentralitas dan graph pengetahuan tak pasti; (iv) menggabungkan grounding retrieval dengan dukungan keputusan LLM-ke-OR portofolio sehingga rencana yang di-grounding dapat ditranspilasi langsung ke tindakan terverifikasi solver di bawah guardrail; dan (v) menstandarisasi evaluasi (deteksi F1, faithfulness, latensi, biaya, dan galat keputusan) agar intelijen gangguan berbasis retrieval menjadi sains yang terukur, dapat diaudit, dan dapat diterapkan.

File_Sumber: Real-Time RAG for the Identification of Supply Chain Vulnerabilities.pdf
Judul: Real-Time RAG for the Identification of Supply Chain Vulnerabilities
Penulis: Jesse Ponnock, Grace Kenneally, Michael Robert Briggs, Elinor Yeo, Tyrone Patterson III, Nicholas Kinberg, Matthew Kalinowski, David Hechtman
Problem: Large Language Models (LLMs) have knowledge bases constrained to their last training date, making them unusable for organizations relying on emerging and timely information. Granular and timely supply chain data is difficult to obtain due to considerable publication delays, aggregated public datasets, or expensive and time-intensive custom data providers. Extracting supply chain information from mandatory regulatory disclosures (SEC filings) remains a manual, challenging task because information is typically in narrative form.
Metodologi: Integrating Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) preprocessing and retrieval techniques with advanced web-scraping technologies. The study evaluates 30 unique configurations encompassing pre-retrieval (upward and downward query abstraction), at-retrieval (dense vs. sparse retrieval, fine-tuning the embedding model), post-retrieval (fixed and adaptive iterative retrieval), and generation (fine-tuning the LLM).
Dataset: A corpus of SEC filings (10-Ks, 10-Qs, 8-Ks, and 14-As) retrieved from the SEC EDGAR system. Evaluation and training data consist of question-passage-answer triplets created through Human Annotation (by SMEs) and Synthetic Generation (using GPT-4o).
Temuan: Fine-tuning the embedding retrieval model consistently provides the most significant performance gains, highlighting the critical importance of retrieval quality. Adaptive iterative retrieval further enhances performance, especially on complex supply chain queries. Downward query abstraction significantly outperforms upward abstraction, and fine-tuning the LLM yields limited improvements at higher resource costs. Human evaluations showed that the adaptive iterative retrieval configuration achieved the highest correct answers (78% accuracy across 210 entries).
Keterbatasan_Penelitian: Due to resource constraints and extensive processing time required for each experimental run, the researchers were unable to thoroughly investigate the statistical significance of their findings.
Future_Work: Optimizing the system's ability to extract and relate firm- and product-specific information, exploring temporal weighting of sources, integrating knowledge graphs to contextualize relationships, expanding real-time data ingestion through internet augmentation, and examining how RAG techniques perform relative to recent innovations in pretraining.

File_Sumber: Enhancing retrieval-augmented generation for interoperable industrial knowledge representation and inference toward cognitive digital twins.pdf
Judul: Enhancing retrieval-augmented generation for interoperable industrial knowledge representation and inference toward cognitive digital twins
Penulis: Dachuan Shi, Jianzhang Li, Olga Meyer, Thomas Bauernhansl
Problem: Kinerja sistem Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) sangat bergantung pada kualitas hasil pengambilan (retrieval), yang dapat dikompromikan oleh pengetahuan spesifik domain dan pendistraksi pengambilan. Pendekatan tradisional seperti ontologi, knowledge graphs (KGs), atau digital twins (DTs) untuk representasi pengetahuan serta algoritma berbasis aturan untuk inferensi menjadi tidak mencukupi karena kurangnya interoperabilitas dan fleksibilitas.
Metodologi: Mengusulkan sistem RAG yang ditingkatkan dalam dua aspek: (1) Menggunakan Asset Administration Shell (AAS) untuk representasi pengetahuan terstandar; (2) Mengusulkan contrastive selection loss (CSL) untuk menyempurnakan (fine-tune) model LLM open-source berbasis arsitektur Siamese network (menggunakan SFR-Embedding-Mistral) guna melakukan listwise entity selection untuk proses reranking. Demonstrasi dilakukan pada kasus integrasi sel kerja robotik dengan protokol evaluasi hibrid dan eksperimen statistik.
Dataset: Kumpulan data pencocokan entitas (entity matching dataset) yang dikompilasi dari repositori kosakata terstandar ECLASS (versi 12 Advanced, berisi 27.423 entitas unik sebagai basis pengetahuan), serta 2522 entitas AAS yang diekstrak dari Submodel KinematicModel dan 57 SMT terstandar dari IDTA (menghasilkan 800 sampel data: 480 pelatihan, 160 validasi, dan 160 pengujian).
Temuan: Sistem RAG yang ditingkatkan dengan AAS dan LLM berfine-tune CSL menunjukkan performa superior dibandingkan metode state-of-the-art lainnya (termasuk GPT-4 dengan in-context learning dan model pairwise terfokus lainnya), dengan peningkatan skor MRR@10 (mencapai lebih dari 71%) dan skor F1 (lebih dari 62%). Dalam studi kasus integrasi sel kerja robotik, pendekatan ini meningkatkan faktualitas (89,0%) dan kelengkapan (81,7%) dibandingkan RAG baseline.
Keterbatasan_Penelitian: Implementasi saat ini belum mengekstraksi file terlampir di dalam paket AASX (seperti PDF, gambar, dan model CAD) sebagai masukan untuk LLM, sehingga belum sepenuhnya memanfaatkan kapabilitas representasi kaya dari AAS. Selain itu, implementasi saat ini terbatas pada prediksi satu kandidat true positive tunggal selama inferensi, yang kurang sesuai jika terdapat banyak true positive.
Future_Work: Memperluas kapabilitas sistem RAG untuk memproses tidak hanya entitas terstruktur di dalam AAS tetapi juga file yang dilampirkan (seperti dokumen teknis dan model CAD). Selain itu, pendekatan reranking harus ditingkatkan lebih lanjut, terutama dalam menangani beberapa kecocokan yang benar (multiple correct matches).

Judul: Supply chain mapping through retrieval-augmented generation: applications to the electronics industry
Penulis: Ilya Jackson, Maria Jesús Saénz, Dmitry Ivanov & Benedict Jun Ma
Problem: Most organizations still lack visibility beyond their Tier 1 suppliers because supply chain mapping traditionally relies on slow, incomplete, and expensive manual data collection and analysis.
Metodologi: The study develops an automated RAG-based framework using OpenAI's GPT-3.5 Turbo to extract entity and relation functions from unstructured public text sources, converting them into a directed supply chain graph via NetworkX, and analyzing the resulting structure using network science metrics (centrality, modularity, path length, and diameter).
Dataset: Unstructured public data sources including SEC 10-K filings, corporate earnings call transcripts, company websites, and Wikipedia pages, with results validated against the S&P Capital IQ ground truth dataset.
Temuan: The proof of concept successfully constructed a directed supply chain graph encompassing 4,644 nodes and 8,341 edges across three major contract manufacturers in the electronics industry (Hon Hai Precision Industry, Flex Ltd., and Jabil Inc.), demonstrating high precision (82.7% overall) in extracting supply chain relationships and revealing high modularity and central intermediary positions.
Keterbatasan_Penelitian: The current implementation focuses on firm headquarters rather than specific locations of production facilities or distribution centres, and the RAG-based methodology is constrained by the retrieval quality and relevance scoring functions of current retrieval models.
Future_Work: Integrate granular data on factory locations, incorporate bill-of-materials level data, utilize advances in LLMs and retrieval techniques to enhance accuracy, and extend the methodology to other industries.

Judul: Inventory optimization under supply chain disruptions: Leveraging large language models for human-AI collaborative decision-making
Problem: Traditional inventory optimization models, such as stochastic programming and robust optimization, depend on complex operations research models and specialized expertise, creating barriers to practical application for non-expert decision-makers. Meanwhile, while large language models (LLMs) excel in text generation and semantic understanding, their direct application to complex optimization problems in dynamic and uncertain environments like supply chain disruptions remains underexplored because LLMs are not inherently designed to solve complex optimization problems involving large solution spaces.
Metodologi: The study proposes a hybrid decision-making framework integrating LLMs with simulation-based optimization (SO) methods, and develops/compares three human-AI collaborative paradigms with varying degrees of automation: (1) Fully Automated Decision-making Optimization (FADO), (2) Two-Stage Automated Simulation and Optimization (TASO) utilizing Genetic Algorithms, and (3) Simulation-Based Human-Specified Optimization (SHSO) utilizing the Adaptive Procedure for Unknown Variance (APUV) ranking-and-selection procedure. Performance is evaluated through extensive numerical experiments measuring the probability of correct selection (PCS) and solution quality.
Temuan: Results show that while FADO offers the greatest automation and ease of implementation, its accuracy and stability are limited. TASO enhances computational robustness but remains sensitive to the granularity of parameters. SHSO consistently achieves statistically optimal and stable outcomes by combining LLM-driven simulation with human-specified algorithms.
Keterbatasan_Penelitian: The study's scope is limited to a simulation-based setting and does not directly benchmark against classical stochastic or robust optimization models.
Future_Work: Future research will extend this framework to empirical datasets, incorporate analytical baselines, relax modeling assumptions (such as incorporating probabilistic warning systems, stochastic lead times, and broader cost structures), and explore the scalability of the LLM-SO framework to more complex, multi-echelon supply-chain structures.

File_Sumber: Knowledge Graph-Guided Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Explainable Supply Chain Resilience Assessment.pdf
Judul: Knowledge graph-guided retrieval-augmented generation for explainable supply chain resilience assessment
Problem: Penilaian ketahanan rantai pasok skala besar memiliki tiga keterbatasan fundamental: (1) model penilaian berbasis aturan seperti AHP dan SCOR mengandalkan rubrik pradefinisi yang tidak dapat menyerap pengetahuan gangguan yang heterogen dan tidak terstruktur; (2) model bahasa besar (LLM) tujuan umum menghasilkan penilaian yang tidak didukung oleh bukti domain, menyebabkan tingkat halusinasi yang tinggi; dan (3) saluran RAG saat ini memisahkan proses retrieval dari inferensi sehingga mengabaikan dependensi struktural yang mengatur propagasi risiko rantai pasok.
Metodologi: Mengusulkan KG-RAF (Knowledge Graph-guided Retrieval-Augmented Framework) yang terdiri dari: (1) knowledge graph rantai pasok bertipe yang mengenkode entitas pemasok, produk, dan kejadian risiko dengan bobot relasional; (2) modul retrieval semantik dua tahap yang memadukan dense encoding dengan re-ranking lingkungan grafik; dan (3) mesin inferensi sadar ketidakpastian yang secara bersama-sama mengoptimalkan skor ketahanan dan verifikasi bukti.
Dataset: Kumpulan data dari tiga koridor publik: Supply Chain Disruption Database (SCDD), pengungkapan risiko SEC Form 10-K, dan laporan insiden industri dari rentang tahun 2015–2023, mencakup 18.742 dokumen di empat sektor industri (otomotif, farmasi, ritel, dan semikonduktor) dengan 6.200 pasang kueri-penilaian beradnotasi pakar.
Temuan: KG-RAF mencapai korelasi Pearson 0.921 dengan anotasi pakar, mengurangi RMSE hingga 51% dibandingkan baseline terkuat, meningkatkan MRR sebesar 21.5%, dan memangkas tingkat halusinasi dari 28.7% menjadi 4.1%.
Future_Work: Mengeksplorasi tiga arah: (1) memperluas knowledge graph ke topologi jaringan multi-tier dan multi-echelon untuk menangkap propagasi risiko hulu melampaui hubungan pemasok langsung; (2) mengintegrasikan sinyal streaming waktu nyata sebagai pembaruan basis pengetahuan dinamis untuk mendeteksi gangguan secara proaktif; dan (3) mengembangkan varian federated yang menjaga privasi dari KG-RAF untuk mendukung benchmarking ketahanan lintas perusahaan tanpa mengeksploitasi data rantai pasok milik perusahaan.

File_Sumber: An Enhanced RAG–LLM Framework for Decision Support in Sustainable Industrial Engineering and Management.pdf
Judul: An Enhanced RAG–LLM Framework for Decision Support in Sustainable Industrial Engineering and Management
Penulis: Yi Zhang, Jing Gu, Yinghui Lang, Yang Qin
Problem: Existing RAG-based decision-support methods focus mainly on enhancing semantic relevance and remain inadequate in industrial knowledge governance, the participation of retrieved evidence throughout the decision process, and the validation of decision results and feedback before implementation, thereby limiting the accuracy, traceability, and reliability of decision outcomes.
Metodologi: Proposing an enhanced RAG-LLM framework that generates governed knowledge units with explicit evidence boundaries from multi-source heterogeneous industrial data, combined with hybrid retrieval, evidence packaging, automated validation, human review, and feedback regulation mechanisms.
Dataset: An experimental dataset based on simulated industrial-enterprise scenarios covering four representative tasks: equipment-fault diagnosis, quality-anomaly analysis, energy optimization, and wastewater-compliance management, consisting of 32 governed knowledge units.
Temuan: The hybrid retrieval strategy improved mean Recall@6 from 0.7917 for BM25 to 1.0000, mean nDCG@6 from 0.8398 to 1.0000, and decreased mean GVR@6 from 0.1667 to 0. The enhanced RAG-LLM maintained high gold-standard source coverage across different LLMs (mean evidence source-ID coverage of 1.0000 for ChatGPT 5.5, 0.9917 for Gemini 3.5 Flash, and 0.9750 for DeepSeek V4 Flash). After introducing feedback regulation before decision implementation, mean evidence source-ID coverage for representative task responses increased from 0.4167 to 1.0000.
Keterbatasan_Penelitian: Integrating multi-source data processing, retrieval augmentation, and LLM reasoning introduces additional computational costs; system scalability remains challenging for massive heterogeneous data in very large industrial enterprises and multi-plant collaborative environments; and effectiveness depends on the availability of high-quality metadata and structured knowledge representations.
Future_Work: Real-time multimodal data integration, privacy-preserving deployment, and long-term validation in real industrial environments.

File_Sumber: LLM-Stochastic Optimization Framework Intelligent SupplyChain Planning with Uncertainty-Aware Inventory Control.pdf
Judul: LLM-Stochastic Optimization Framework: Intelligent Supply Chain Planning with Uncertainty-Aware Inventory Control
Problem: Effective supply chain management under demand and lead-time uncertainties suffers from three fundamental limitations: (1) inability to interpret complex natural language planning objectives and orchestrate multi-modal analytical workflows, (2) reliance on deterministic inventory models that inadequately capture stochastic supply-demand dynamics, and (3) lack of integrated frameworks bridging strategic decision-making with operational execution.
Metodologi: Mengusulkan kerangka kerja LLM-SIO (LLM-Stochastic Inventory Optimization) yang menggabungkan agen berbasis LLM dengan memori tambahan dan RAG untuk orkestrasi tugas, serta model pemrograman stokastik dua tahap dengan simulasi Monte Carlo untuk optimasi stok pengaman di bawah ketidakpastian ganda, yang divalidasi menggunakan mekanisme closed-loop antara pencarian kebijakan offline dan eksekusi Material Requirements Planning (MRP) online.
Dataset: Dataset rantai pasok multi-produk dunia nyata dari perusahaan manufaktur global yang mencakup catatan harian untuk 127 Stock-Keeping Units (SKU) di beberapa pusat distribusi dari bulan April hingga September 2020.
Temuan: LLM-SIO mencapai tingkat layanan (service level) rata-rata sebesar 94,2% dengan pengurangan biaya penyimpanan inventaris total sebesar 18% dibandingkan metode baseline konvensional, serta menghasilkan RMSE 47,3 unit pada prediksi inventaris dan MAPE 12,7% pada peramalan konsumsi permintaan.
Future_Work: (1) Memperluas kerangka kerja ke jaringan pasokan multi-eselon dengan kemampuan transshipment lateral, (2) Memasukkan reinforcement learning untuk adaptasi kebijakan dinamis di bawah lingkungan non-stasioner.

File_Sumber: Application of retrieval-augmented generation for interactive industrial knowledge management via a large language model.pdf
Judul: Application of retrieval-augmented generation for interactive industrial knowledge management via a large language model
Penulis: Lun-Chi Chen, Mayuresh Sunil Pardeshi, Yi-Xiang Liao, Kai-Chih Pai
Problem: Industrial data processing and retrieval face challenges in domain-specific applications due to specialized terminology and context. Managing nonrecorded-based domain-specific databases is difficult, and handling numerous service center calls at peak hours with limited human service providers leads to delays, unhandled error messages, and increased employee workload.
Metodologi: Designing an Interactive Industrial Knowledge Management (IIKM) system utilizing a customized Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-based Large Language Model architecture. The model incorporates BM25 and embedding sequence processing in a chroma database, where the top k-chunks are selected and reranked using the BAAI ranker (cross-encoder), followed by response generation using GPT-3.5 Turbo.
Dataset: A group of documents with a total size of 234 MB in pdf, pptx, docx, csv, and txt formats, categorized into Service Center (product details, manuals, troubleshooting, maintenance information) and Organizational Regulations (employee benefits, leave regulations, customer management).
Temuan: In technical service applications, the IIKM system achieved a Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) of 88%, a recall of 85%, and a Mean Average Precision (mAP) of 75%. For internal regulatory documents, the generation-based retrieval evaluation prediction achieved a recall of 97.97% (note: text also mentions 91.62% recall, 97.97% MRR, and 91.12% mAP in different sections), significantly reducing query response time from approximately two minutes (manual) to three to five seconds.
Keterbatasan_Penelitian: Hallucinations within the IIKM system response were observed due to open LLM limitations and incorrect document retrieval, particularly for technical queries where fault code documents were very similar.
Future_Work: Adding the feature of a multilanguage support option and improving the LLM prompt engineering capability.

File_Sumber: A Multi-Agent Framework for Multi-Source Manufacturing Knowledge Integration and Question Answering.pdf
Judul: A Multi-Agent Framework for Multi-Source Manufacturing Knowledge Integration and Question Answering
Problem: Effective management and utilization of dispersed and complex manufacturing knowledge pose a significant challenge due to the heterogeneity of knowledge modalities (text files, spreadsheets, traditional databases, CAD drawings, technical manuals, process flow documents), the complexity of knowledge systems across product lifecycles, and the complexity of knowledge search scenarios (fault descriptions, product model inquiries, process parameter consultations, interpretations of technical standards). Traditional knowledge management approaches also suffer from loosely structured organization, unidimensional retrieval techniques, maintenance/updating challenges, and a lack of intelligent knowledge services.
Metodologi: Proposes a Multi-Agent-based, Multi-Source, and Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework specifically designed for manufacturing. The methodology includes: (1) Multi-source knowledge integration comprising multimodal document parsing (using MLLMs for layout analysis, OCR, structure-based segmentation, cosine similarity for chunking, and cross-modal information fusion), knowledge graph construction (using an agent-based reasoning system, knowledge retrieval module, memory module, and information extraction module), and relational database parsing (converting records to structured text and high-dimensional embedding vectors); (2) Multi-agent search framework featuring a Router Agent, Knowledge Graph QA Agent, Document QA Agent, Relational DB QA Agent, and Aggregator Agent; and (3) Thinking RAG optimization focusing on query understanding/clarification, multi-source information integration, and answer diversity/explainability.
Dataset: A comprehensive dataset integrating multiple sources, comprising 60% document data (technical manuals, maintenance guides), 20% knowledge graph data (stored in Neo4j), and 20% relational database data (product info and work order records from enterprise systems). High-quality Q&A pairs (factual, diagnostic, recommendation-based) were generated using the GPT-4o model. The total dataset consists of 10,000 samples divided into training (7000 samples / 70%), validation (1500 samples / 15%), and testing (1500 samples / 15%) subsets.
Temuan: Experimental results using NDCG@3 and Faithfulness metrics show that Naive RAG achieved an NDCG@3 of 80% and Faithfulness of 73%. Enhancing the framework with a multi-agent system significantly improved performance to 90% NDCG@3 and 84% Faithfulness. Further integration of the Thinking RAG model maintained NDCG@3 at 90% and increased Faithfulness to 87%.
Future_Work: Concentrate on further experimental validation and the integration of real-time user feedback to dynamically update and refine the framework, ensuring its responsiveness to the evolving demands of the manufacturing industry and its stakeholders.

File_Sumber: Knowledge graph-guided retrieval-augmented generation forexplainable supply chain resilience assessment.pdf
Judul: Knowledge graph-guided retrieval-augmented generation for explainable supply chain resilience assessment
Problem: Penilaian ketahanan rantai pasok (supply chain resilience) berskala besar menghadapi tiga keterbatasan mendasar: (1) Model penilaian berbasis aturan seperti AHP dan SCOR mengandalkan rubrik pradefinisi yang tidak dapat menyerap pengetahuan gangguan yang heterogen dan tidak terstruktur; (2) Large Language Models (LLM) tujuan umum menghasilkan penilaian yang tidak didukung oleh bukti domain, menyebabkan tingkat halusinasi yang tinggi; (3) Pipeline retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) saat ini memisahkan proses retrieval dari inferensi, sehingga mengabaikan dependensi struktural yang mengatur propagasi risiko rantai pasok.
Metodologi: Mengusulkan KG-RAF (Knowledge Graph-guided Retrieval-Augmented Framework) yang mencakup: (1) Knowledge graph rantai pasok bertipe yang mengodekan entitas pemasok, produk, dan kejadian risiko dengan bobot tepi relasional; (2) Modul retrieval semantik dua tahap yang dipandu KG yang menggabungkan pengodean dense dengan re-ranking lingkungan graf; (3) Mesin inferensi sadar ketidakpastian (uncertainty-aware) yang secara bersama-sama mengoptimalkan skoring ketahanan dan verifikasi bukti.
Dataset: Kumpulan data benchmark yang bersumber dari Supply Chain Disruption Database (SCDD), pengungkapan risiko SEC Form 10-K, dan laporan insiden industri (2015-2023) yang mencakup 18.742 dokumen di empat sektor industri (otomotif, farmasi, ritel, dan semikonduktor) dengan 6.200 pasang kueri-penilaian beradnotasi ahli.
Temuan: KG-RAF mencapai korelasi Pearson 0.921 dengan adnotasi ahli, mengurangi RMSE hingga 51% dibandingkan baseline terkuat, menurunkan tingkat halusinasi dari 28,7% menjadi 4,1%, serta mempertahankan performa yang kuat di bawah noise basis pengetahuan, input out-of-distribution, perturbasi adversarial, dan peristiwa gangguan Black Swan di dunia nyata.
Future_Work: Future work akan mengeksplorasi tiga arah: (1) memperluas knowledge graph ke topologi jaringan multi-tier dan multi-echelon untuk menangkap propagasi risiko hULU di luar hubungan pemasok langsung; (2) mengintegrasikan sinyal streaming real-time sebagai pembaruan basis pengetahuan dinamis untuk mendeteksi gangguan secara proaktif; dan (3) mengembangkan varian federated KG-RAF yang menjaga privasi untuk mendukung benchmarking ketahanan lintas perusahaan tanpa mengeksploitasi data rantai pasok berpemilik.

Judul: A Cognitive Digital Twin for Industry 5.0 Based on a Large Language Model Agent
Penulis: Shanhe Lou, Mengchu Zhou, Runjia Tan, Chen Lv
Problem: Kemampuan kognitif digital twin (DT) saat ini masih belum memadai untuk mengatasi kompleksitas dinamis dalam manufaktur (seperti variasi proses, fluktuasi lingkungan, dan interaksi manusia), sehingga menghambat penerapannya di era Industri 5.0 yang menekankan kemampuan kognitif Self-X.
Metodologi: Mengusulkan kerangka kerja lima dimensi yang ditingkatkan untuk Cognitive Digital Twin (CDT) dengan agen Large Language Model (LLM) sebagai intinya. Menggunakan Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) berbasis Industrial Knowledge Graph (IKG) untuk membangun kesadaran konteks dan pembelajaran in-context (in-context learning) sedikit contoh (few-shot), serta teknologi LiDAR-camera fusion SLAM untuk pemodelan lingkungan secara real-time.
Temuan: Pendekatan CDT berbasis IKG-RAG dengan in-context learning few-shot menunjukkan performa yang memuaskan pada perencanaan tugas perintah normal dan mengungguli mode lain dalam perencanaan tugas berbasis umpan balik dinamis (menangani insiden seperti kesalahan genggam dan objek salah tempat).
Keterbatasan_Penelitian: Pendekatan ini memiliki keterbatasan dalam menangani permintaan yang tidak pasti dan dapat menghasilkan aksi berhalusinasi dalam rencana tugas (misalnya, gagal berinteraksi dengan manusia untuk mengklarifikasi perintah yang ambigu seperti memilih obeng di workstation, atau menghasilkan lokasi yang tidak ditentukan seperti 'Shelf' yang tidak diketahui meskipun subgraf menunjukkan benda berada di 'Tray 1').
Future_Work: Merencanakan untuk menyempurnakan proses pengambilan (retrieval) dengan melakukan vektorisasi IKG dan fine-tuning agen LLM guna mengurangi ketergantungan pada pengambilan berbasis kesamaan bahasa dan memitigasi misinterpretasi yang disebabkan oleh perintah manusia yang tidak pasti atau ambigu.
